content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NFDC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NFDC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NFDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the NFDC Recruitment 2026 is 27th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this NFDC recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for various posts, including Sr. Executive Assistant, Editor cum Graphic Designer, Video cum Photographer, and Content Writer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Sr. Executive Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Sr. Executive Assistant position, candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree. Other posts have different specific educational requirements.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NFDC recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts in this NFDC recruitment is 35 years. Specific age relaxation details are not provided in the current data.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Sr. Executive Assistant post?
faq.answer: The Sr. Executive Assistant post offers a consolidated salary of Rs. 70,000/- per month. Other posts have a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided information, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this NFDC recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the NFDC recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the NFDC Recruitment 2026 is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity. The selected candidates will be appointed on a contractual basis by the National Film Development Corporation.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the NFDC located?
faq.answer: The National Film Development Corporation (NFDC) is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with a pincode of 400026.

faq.question: Q10. What are the key responsibilities of a Content Writer in this role?
faq.answer: A Content Writer is expected to have a Graduate degree in English/Journalism/Mass Communication and will likely be involved in creating and editing written content related to film and NFDC's activities.
